features: 25x Optical Zoom Camera: Pull faraway action into sharp focus with a 24mm wide angle lens covering sweeping landscapes to tight close-ups of wildlife, stage performers, and kids on the field; real optical reach, not a digital crop

16MP CMOS Sensor: Capture vibrant, high-resolution photos with accurate color across changing light; images stay sharp enough to print large, crop deep, and share from birthday parties and vacations to wildlife outings

Optical Image Stabilization: Keep handheld shots sharp at every zoom level; built-in OIS counters hand shake at long focal lengths, the difference between a keeper and a blurred frame when you cannot step closer

Runs on AA Batteries: Never get stranded by a dead proprietary pack; this bridge camera takes standard AA cells sold at any gas station or grocery worldwide, ready for road trips, camping, and international travel

1080p Full HD Video: Record smooth video of travel, family events, and everyday moments; transfer to your computer over USB for sharing and printing; works with Class 10 SD, SDHC, or SDXC cards up to 512GB
description: For over a century, KODAK has made photography simple and accessible—and the PIXPRO AZ255 continues that tradition as one of the most capable bridge cameras at its price point. Equipped with 25x optical zoom and a 24mm wide angle lens, the AZ255 bridges the gap between compact cameras and heavier DSLRs, delivering true optical clarity that smartphone digital zoom simply cannot match across any subject or distance.A 16MP CMOS sensor captures detailed, vibrant photos in a variety of conditions, while optical image stabilization keeps handheld shots sharp even at maximum zoom reach. Powered by standard AA batteries available anywhere in the world, the AZ255 is always ready for road trips, camping weekends, and international travel without hunting for proprietary chargers. Full 1080p HD video records smooth family memories and travel adventures, and photos transfer easily via USB to your computer for sharing and printing. Whether photographing wildlife in the field, grandkids at a recital, or landscapes on a road trip, this reliable travel companion delivers.
